content: Issue #1 scope decisions (2026-07-24, devague frame issue-1-engine-extraction): (1) numpy = BASE dependency, zero-dep property consciously given up; (2) own XDG state dir $FACE_RECOGNITION_STATE_DIR -> $XDG_STATE_HOME/face-recognition-cli -> ~/.local/state/face-recognition-cli, with PER-CONSUMER BANKS: banks/<consumer>/ (own faces.json + embeddings/) selected by --bank flag + env override, models/ shared across banks; reachy injects base_dir= or adopts a named bank; (3) temp tier ported as-is; (4) verbs take image path AND stdin (- convention), engine-only, no cameras; (5) backend stays colleague, devex needs --agent claude-code override.
